summary: Container map of the whole demo: web talks to bff over AG-UI/session SSE, the claude CLI (spawned per role) is given only policy-mcp, which proxies shop-mcp and ops-mcp onto search-svc and the shared data stores.

name: Deep tracing
summary: Every turn is one trace: a turn root span in the bff, router/llm/tool/state/verifier/budget/error spans at the code points that do the work, policy spans in policy-mcp and retrieval spans in search-svc under the same traceId (W3C traceparent), plus hitl and feedback spans that land on the turn later. Spans are written to data/traces/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (on by default, TRACE_FILE=0 disables), OTLP to Jaeger stays optional, prompts and shopper text are hashed unless OTEL_CAPTURE_CONTENT=1. See docs/TRACING.md.

stories.then: it returns one span tree rooted at `turn shopper` with `kind_counts` spanning router, llm, tool, policy, retrieval, state and ui
